summary.headline: Treya Partners uncovers $1.1 M in annual savings across eight APDerm spend categories
summary.narrative: Working with APDerm, Treya Partners completed or advanced strategic sourcing initiatives in eight indirect categories. The team has already finalized savings in Office Supplies and secured fully-executed agreements or active implementations in Medical Supplies, Small Parcel, Courier Services, Telecom, IT Hardware, and Contact Center solutions. An additional broker review for Employee Benefits is underway. In total, $1,097,298 in annual savings has been identified—$13,694 already finalized and $1,083,604 in various stages of implementation.

summary.headline: APDerm captures $1.18M in annualized savings across 12 spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ two-phase sourcing program for APDerm has locked in $1.16 million of recurring savings and identified a further $23 thousand that is now moving through contracting. Ten categories—including Medical Supplies, Courier Services and a renegotiated AthenaHealth billing agreement—are fully implemented, while three more categories (Temp Labor, Copiers/Print and Uniforms) are on track for completion. Key wins include a 27 % reduction on medical supplies with McKesson and a 17 % fee reduction on patient billing services.
